name: Aiiro no Kankei
source:
One day main character's father suddenly dies in an traffic accident. But cruel father leaves his young and beautiful widow behind. Step-mother, childhood friend and a teacher - what do they all find in protagonist?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某天，主人公的父亲突然因交通事故去世。但残忍的父亲留下了年轻貌美的遗孀。继母、青梅竹马和老师——她们在主人公身上看到了什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
